why: The project's 300 MW load assumes 121 diesel generators (2,500 kW each, total 302.5 MW) yielding an estimated NOx potential-to-emit of 1,067 tpy, exceeding the 100 tpy major-source threshold under 40 CFR 70.2 and triggering a federal Title V operating permit requirement. Washington County's moratorium (ORD-2026-12) is in effect from June 30, 2026 through December 27, 2026 (180 days) and pauses acceptance, processing, reviewing, and approval of all data center applications countywide, which the finding confirms applies to the site as of 2026-10-26. The moratorium exempts only uses with a current Certificate of Use & Occupancy as of the effective date, but the project's permit status is null and the finding indicates the moratorium applies. With an active local permitting block and a definite major federal air permit required, the project cannot proceed now.
